title: Bizzy's Tooltopia (TEXTURE PACK EDITION)
description: This is a neat and cartoony texture pack I made for my mod Bizzy's Tooltopia!
body:
This is a Texture Pack I made for my mod Bizzy's Tooltopia for people who liked my cartoonyish art style! Changes stuff like dirt, snow, oak, etc! Updates won't be very frequent. Reccomended to use with my mod [Bizzy's Tooltopia!](https://modrinth.com/mod/bizzys_tooltopia)!

Note: Mod was made using 1.20.1 files.
